draft.emotion: matter-of-fact and clear, identifying something that has just arrived
notes: With people, it means 'young' (and as a noun, ο νέος / η νέα means 'young man / woman'). With things or situations, it usually means 'new, another, latest' (μια νέα αρχή, 'a new beginning').
For physical objects that are brand new or recently bought, use καινούργιος instead (ένα καινούργιο αυτοκίνητο, 'a new car').

draftBefore.emotion: matter-of-fact and clear, identifying something that has just arrived
notes: As an adjective, νέος changes its ending to match the gender and case of the noun it describes. In the feminine, it becomes νέα, and in the neuter, νέο.
When it describes a person, it means 'young'. When it describes an object, it means 'new'.
Do not confuse this with 'καινούργιος', which almost always means 'brand new' or 'recently made'. 'Νέος' is broader and can refer to youth or something fresh.
